ai.title: Inject model id into base2 system prompt
ai.summary: Extracts model selection into const model in agents/base2/base2.ts and interpolates it into Codebuff Meta-information section. Provides runtime model awareness to agent. Minor refactor for prompt context.

eli5.text: When you chat with the assistant, it now knows which underlying engine is powering its responses, and that fact is stated right up front in its opening instructions. The assistant picks one of two engines depending on your selected mode and injects that engine's name into its system prompt. If you look at the conversation, you'd see a new line near the top that reads, "You are running on the [engine name] model," telling you exactly which version is active for that session.

ai.title: Fireworks API supports reasoningeffort parameter
ai.summary: web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts transforms OpenRouter-style reasoning objects into Fireworks' reasoning_effort field. Default effort is medium; enabled defaults true. Fireworks supports reasoning_effort alongside function tools (GLM-4.5/5.1, Kimi K2).

eli5.text: When you ask a specific AI model through the internal system, it can now think through problems more carefully before replying, rather than always working at a medium level of effort. You don't need to do anything different: if you've already told the system to use more thorough reasoning, it will apply that; otherwise it keeps working the way it did before. Nothing changes for you today, but the system is now ready to support deeper think-throughs if that setting is turned on later.
